title: Pentaho Developer - DI Practitioner
description: Self-paced, hands-on workshop for the Pentaho Data Integration Practitioner.

assistant.subject: Pentaho Data Integration (Spoon, transformations, jobs and the Pentaho Server)
suggestions: Walk me through my first transformation
What's the difference between a job and a transformation?
How do I read a CSV and filter rows?
What PDI skills does this course teach?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and how to set your machine up — whether you are on a lab VM or installing on your own laptop. Five minutes here makes every later lab smoother.

moduleSummaries.title: Components & Concepts
moduleSummaries.summary: The pieces of Pentaho and the vocabulary that runs through every later lab. Meet the client tools and server components, configure Spoon and the KETTLE variables that drive it, then build a 'Hello World' transformation covering steps, hops, rows and the run/preview cycle — finishing with logging and error handling.

moduleSummaries.title: Data Sources
moduleSummaries.summary: Read and write the formats and systems you'll meet daily — text, JSON, XML, Excel; relational databases (CRUID + slowly changing dimensions); and the big-data layer: Hadoop, Jupyter, SMB, Snowflake, MinIO.

moduleSummaries.title: Enriching the Dataset
moduleSummaries.summary: Shape data inside the pipeline: joins (database, merge, XML, row), lookups, merge-streams patterns, and scripting (Formula, Modified JavaScript Value) when SQL alone isn't enough.

moduleSummaries.title: Enterprise Solution
moduleSummaries.summary: Move from individual transformations to production: jobs, parameters and variables, and scalability (master/slave, partitioning). Get your pipelines ready for scheduling, monitoring, and shipping.

moduleSummaries.title: Capstone Project
moduleSummaries.summary: Bring it all together: build a parameterised job that ingests CSV, JSON, and master data, validates and enriches the rows, tracks historical changes with an SCD, and loads a dimensional model — a complete, interview-ready pipeline.
